summary: Verified new Challenges + Binance Pay purchase feature end-to-end. Backend unit tests (10 in test_binance_pay.py + 6 new edge cases in test_binance_pay_extended.py) all pass. Full code review of binance_pay.py, purchase_routes.py, models.py + seed.py migration, and AdminPortal PurchasesPanel. Frontend was tested against a stubbed VPS API (Playwright route interception on **/api/challenges/plans and **/api/challenges/purchase) with a seeded fake JWT — all plan rendering, purchase overlay, copy-to-clipboard, digits-only input stripping, inline short-id validation, success/error responses and auth gate flows work. One minor auth-related UX bug found (see below).

minor.issue: The total count is computed by loading every purchase.id into Python (len(scalars().all())) instead of SELECT COUNT(*). Fine for early volumes but should be swapped to a scalar count() before production scale.

ui_bugs.issue: When GET /api/challenges/plans returns 401 the page calls navigate('/login') but the stale bfg_token is NOT cleared, so Login.jsx's useEffect immediately bounces back to /demo-trade. Effective destination on a 401 is /demo-trade, not /login as the spec requires. Fix: on 401 in load(), remove localStorage bfg_token (and any refresh keys) BEFORE navigating to /login, e.g. localStorage.removeItem('bfg_token').

action_items: ChallengesPage: clear bfg_token on 401 from /api/challenges/plans before navigate('/login') so the redirect actually lands on the login screen instead of /demo-trade.
(Nit) Replace admin_purchases total = len(scalars().all()) with a SELECT COUNT(*) scalar to avoid loading every row for the count.
critical_code_review_comments: binance_pay.verify_payment: HMAC-SHA256 signing of urlencoded params + X-MBX-APIKEY header matches Binance /sapi/v1/pay/transactions spec. LOOKBACK_MS = 24*60*60*1000 (verified 24.0 h — not 72).

purchase_routes: PurchaseRequest.order_id validator rejects non-digits (isdigit) and length 6..40 — good. Duplicate protection is layered: unique constraint on challenge_purchases.order_id + explicit SELECT check before verify. Re-purchase of an already-unlocked plan returns 409. Only plan['locked']==True plans can be purchased.

Wallet funding: creates or updates the per-plan Wallet row (wallet_type=key, currency=USD) with the full challenge balance; profile.unlocked_accounts is merged (not overwritten) and active_account is switched to the newly purchased plan.

Challenge row: profit_target, max_daily_loss, max_total_loss and duration_days are computed from ACCOUNT_PLANS. Premium's daily_loss_pct = None is safely coerced to 100 via `rules.get('daily_loss_pct') or 100` so max_daily_loss = account_size (effectively 'no daily limit') — does not crash.

Client-visible response only includes safe fields (id, plan, balance, purchase dict). Raw Binance payload is stored in ChallengePurchase.raw but NOT returned to the client (nor are API keys ever exposed).

Schema: /app/backend/seed.py challenge_purchases migration matches models.ChallengePurchase — VARCHAR(64) unique order_id, VARCHAR(30) plan, NUMERIC(20,4) amount, ON DELETE CASCADE on user_id, ON DELETE SET NULL on challenge_id, index on (user_id, created_at DESC).

AdminPortal PurchasesPanel: table has all 12 columns (user, plan, amount, currency, order id, type, payer binance id, payer name, receiver id, account size, paid at, status). Row click opens admin-purchase-detail modal with the full detail grid + payer/receiver/paid_at/created_at. Testids admin-purchases-table, admin-purchase-detail present. Uses adminApi client (bfg_admin_token).

ChallengesPage: 3-card layout, testids match spec (challenge-plan-<k>, plan-price-<k>, purchase-btn-<k>, plan-owned-<k>, purchase-overlay, purchase-title, binance-pay-option, pay-amount, binance-id-value, binance-name-value, copy-binance-id-btn, order-id-input, verify-payment-btn, purchase-error, purchase-close-btn). order-id-input uses onChange replace(/[^0-9]/g,'') so 'abc123def456' → '123456' (verified). Short-id (<6) inline error blocks API call (verified — no POST fired).
test_credentials: Not needed — Playwright stubbed the VPS API and seeded a fake non-expired JWT (bfg_token). No real login performed (VPS still runs older code).
seed_data_creation: None — all data was Playwright-mocked; no DB writes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints only exist in this repo (not on the VPS at https://api.binaryfundglobal.com). Any real HTTP call to /api/challenges/* will 404 until the user redeploys. Always use Playwright request interception. Backend verification = python3 /app/tests/test_binance_pay.py and /app/tests/test_binance_pay_extended.py (both exit 0). The one open issue is the 401->/login redirect being intercepted by Login.jsx's isLoggedIn() shortcut in ChallengesPage.jsx:173 — clear the token before navigating.

rca of the issue.bug: 401 from /api/challenges/plans lands the user on /demo-trade instead of /login
rca of the issue.reproduction: 1) seed a fake but non-expired bfg_token in localStorage; 2) visit /challenges with the plans endpoint returning 401; 3) observe page.url ends up at /demo-trade.
rca of the issue.root_cause: ChallengesPage.load() catches 401 and calls navigate('/login') but does not remove localStorage.bfg_token first. Login.jsx has useEffect(() => { if (isLoggedIn()) navigate('/demo-trade', {replace:true}); }, []) — since isLoggedIn() only checks token presence + JWT exp claim (never validates against backend), the stale token still qualifies and the user is instantly bounced to /demo-trade.
rca of the issue.mitigation: In ChallengesPage.jsx line ~173 do `localStorage.removeItem('bfg_token');` (and any refresh/session keys) BEFORE navigate('/login?next=/challenges'). Alternatively, in Login.jsx, skip the auto-redirect when the URL carries a `next` query so a forced redirect can settle.
